parties: Sammaan Capital Limited (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance Limited)
headline: Sammaan Capital Limited allots ₹280 cr in secured NCDs across two series
sum: Sammaan Capital (formerly IHFL) allotted ₹280 crore in secured, rated, listed non-convertible debentures in two tranches on 5 March 2026: Series I (₹125 cr, 12,500 debentures of ₹1 lakh face value) and Series II (₹155 cr, 15,500 debentures of ₹1 lakh face value), both redeemable and listed.
implication: The rebranding from Indiabulls Housing Finance to Sammaan Capital reflects a strategic repositioning; the dual-series NCD structure with secured status and listing suggests a refinanced housing finance playbook moving into broader capital markets debt, requiring SEBI listing compliance and RBI NBFC-HFC (if applicable) oversight of instrument terms.
detail: The allotment was authorised by Board resolution dated 3 September 2025 and approved by the Securities Issuance and Investment Committee on 27 February 2026. Both Series I and Series II debentures are secured, rated, listed, redeemable and non-convertible; the secured status indicates backing by specific assets. The combined issue size of ₹280 crore positions Sammaan Capital to refinance or expand its lending book. The dual-tranche structure with different coupon/tenor terms (inferred from separate series naming) provides flexibility across investor preferences.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations, 2021
framework.note: Central; governs NCD issuance, listing, disclosure, rating and investor protection for secured/unsecured tranches.

framework.ref: RBI Master Direction on Non-Banking Financial Company – Housing Finance Company (NBFC-HFC) Regulations, 2021
framework.note: Central if Sammaan remains classified as HFC; sets capital adequacy, asset classification, and lending limits.
Governs issue and allotment of debentures; Board and shareholder approvals.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: Amended; requires stock exchange notification, continuous disclosure, investor reporting and auditor certification for listed NCDs.

framework.ref: National Stock Exchange of India Limited – Listing Rules for Debt Securities
framework.note: Sets format of allotment intimation, settlement and listing procedures; primary venue for this issue.

framework.ref: RBI Master Direction on Acceptance of Public Deposits by NBFCs (RP) (Amendment) Directions, 2021
framework.note: If applicable; governs security, tenure and terms of deposits/debentures issued by the NBFC.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 – Section 194LD (TDS on NCD interest)
framework.note: 10% TDS on debenture interest; withholding obligation for issuer/debenture trustee.
Rated status requires compliance with CRA disclosure and rating maintenance standards.

structure.consideration: ₹280 crore: Series I ₹125 crore (12,500 debentures × ₹1,00,000 face value); Series II ₹155 crore (15,500 debentures × ₹1,00,000 face value). Pricing/coupon of individual series not disclosed in primary filing.
conditions: Securities Issuance and Investment Committee approval dated 27 February 2026
Secured status (specific charge/security interest over assets not detailed in filing)
Credit rating assigned by SEBI-registered CRA (identity not stated in filing)
approvals: NSE listing approval (evidenced by allotment intimation filing)
SEBI LODR compliance certification (presumed; not separately filed)
RBI approval (if applicable for NBFC-HFC; not disclosed in filing)
structure.novel: Rebranding from Indiabulls Housing Finance to Sammaan Capital accompanied by dual-series NCD issue; secured status and formal listing suggest shift from private placement to institutional debt capital markets. Series-wise segmentation allows differentiated tenor/coupon targeting without single-tranche coupon compression.

triggers.note: Mandatory exchange intimation of allotment within 2 days; this NSE filing is the compliance artefact.
If ₹280 cr is part of a larger public issue, substantive ICDR chapters on disclosure, rating, and trustee duties apply.

triggers.law: RBI Master Direction on NBFC-HFC, 2021 – Section 6 (Borrowings)
triggers.note: Caps on borrowing-to-asset ratio; debt issuance counts toward total borrowings cap if HFC classification persists.
10% TDS withholding on coupon payments; withholding agent duty falls on Sammaan or debenture trustee.

firms.note: No legal counsel identified in NSE allotment intimation. Typically IHFL (now Sammaan) has retained internal/in-house legal for Board-authorised debt issuance of this scale; external counsel names withheld from regulatory filing.
